segments.text: Again, hence Judge of the antiquity of the love of God to believers; what an antient friend he hath been to us; who loved us, provided for us; and contrived all our happiness, before we were, yea, before the world was; we reap the fruits of this Covenant now; the seed whereof was sown from Eternity; yea, it is not only ancient, but also most free: no excellencies of ours could engage the love of God, for as yet we were not.
